candidate.rationale: Matches the ToOwned trait contract: the owned String must have the same deep spec view as the source &str. This precisely captures that get_owned produces a String with the same sequence of chars (spec content).
risks: Very small risk if an implementation performed Unicode normalization (it does not): the spec assumes identical Seq<char> content.
If the external implementation diverged or panicked, the postcondition says nothing about divergence (postconditions apply on returning).
